import json, subprocess, sys

def run(scn):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/workspace/submission/bridge.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(scn).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode:
        return {'ERROR': p.stderr.decode()}
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

    r = run(scn)

        print("  ", json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=True))
    for label, raw in r.get('origins', {}).items():
        print("  origin", label, "->", repr(bytes.fromhex(raw).decode('latin-1')) if raw else "''")
